title: Prepare covariates

blocks.what_we_do: Join age and ten within-cohort PCs to the retained sample IDs, and check completeness and rank.
blocks.why: Covariates adjust the comparison for measured predictors and structure. Misaligned covariates can invalidate every variant test while still producing plausible-looking output. Missing covariates remove observations from a model. Collinearity occurs when one column can be predicted exactly from others, preventing a unique estimate. We verify matching IDs and a full-rank design before scanning. Sex is read from PSAM and requested in the PLINK model.
blocks.you_need: State 5.7; cohort eigenvectors from 5.7; metadata from 2.7.
blocks.command:
```{r s6-3}
psam <- guided_table(paste0(guided_path(cfg, "5.7"), ".psam"))
pcs <- guided_table(paste0(guided_path(cfg, "5.7", "pca"), ".eigenvec"))
metadata <- guided_metadata(cfg)
a <- match(psam$IID, metadata$IID); b <- match(psam$IID, pcs$IID)
stopifnot(!anyNA(a), !anyNA(b), !anyDuplicated(pcs$IID))
covar <- data.frame(FID = psam$FID, IID = psam$IID, Age = as.numeric(metadata$Age[a]))
for (name in paste0("PC", 1:10)) covar[[name]] <- as.numeric(pcs[[name]][b])
stopifnot(!anyNA(covar))
design <- model.matrix(~ ., data = data.frame(SEX = as.numeric(psam$SEX), covar[, -(1:2)]))
stopifnot(qr(design)$rank == ncol(design))
names(covar)[1] <- "#FID"
guided_write(covar, guided_path(cfg, "6.3", "covariates.tsv"))
guided_artifact_checkpoint(cfg, "6.3", guided_path(cfg, "6.3", "covariates.tsv"), parent = "6.1")
```

Plain PLINK 2 command (use `bin\plink2.exe` on Windows):

Not applicable: no PLINK operation is needed for this R-only or laboratory step. The R chunk is the complete command; PLINK cannot perform a laboratory measurement.

R reads or calculates the displayed values without changing the genotype files.
blocks.expected_result:
1,811 complete matched covariate rows with Age and PC1 to PC10. No duplicate or unmatched IDs; the design has full column rank.

The tested PLINK version is defined in `config.R` and recorded in
`software_versions.txt`. Validation: executable chunks passed on Windows; main test counts and significance match the instructor reference.
blocks.troubleshooting: Stop at the first error. Check the named input and the previous step. Keep the command and console logs; do not substitute files from a different dataset version. See [troubleshooting](../docs/troubleshooting.md).
blocks.quick_check:
Why is a complete covariate table with the right number of rows insufficient by itself?

<details><summary>Show the answer</summary>

The rows must belong to the correct sample IDs and be aligned to those samples.

</details>
